firstScreen.notes: dist/index.html hero: h1 'San Antonio electrical work, written into your panel schedule' is 8 words, trade+city+outcome. Phone visible in header and mobile bar. Breaker mosaic signals signature. Responsive CSS ensures h1 ≤4 lines at 390×844 with CTAs above fold.

distinctiveness.notes: dist/index.html: Panel Schedule Flip signature in hero (breaker mosaic), services (circuit cards), reviews (filing layout), footer (data-sw-signature='panel-schedule'). Palette (Charcoal/Cream/Amber) differs from generic electrician blue. DM Mono labels reinforce technical identity.

type.notes: dist/index.html: Oswald/Karla/DM Mono pairing. Display tracking -0.03em. Body ≥16px, measure 64ch. Tabular numerals on [data-count]. Kicker labels in DM Mono uppercase. Scale contrast in h1 vs body.

layout.notes: dist/index.html: Tone alternation deep/paper/mid/paper/deep/mid/deep/mid. No adjacent same-tone sections. Varied shapes: split hero, status band, circuit-rail, centered ZIP, ledger table, centered form. Footer uses signature circuit structurally.

photo.notes: dist/index.html: Placeholder mode per task instructions. Images have alt text and aspect-ratio frames. CSS grade filter (grayscale+sepia+contrast+brightness with tone blend modes) will unify real photos. No off-topic frames or duplicates in markup.

copy.notes: dist/index.html: Headlines answer homeowner questions. Technical voice ('lug torqued to spec', 'rated connectors'). Sample labels on every review, price row, and license. No banned phrases. Consistent primary action naming.

mobile.notes: dist/index.html CSS: .mobile-bar fixed bottom with hide/show toggle. Nav collapses to burger <768px. Tap targets ≥48px. Grid gutter reduces to 16px. Circuit cards stack vertically. No horizontal scroll triggers.

a11y.notes: dist/index.html: Skip link, 3px accent focus outline with 3px offset. All inputs labeled. ZIP aria-live region. Reduced-motion safety net. Forced-colors borders. Heading order correct. Honeypot hidden.

motion.notes: dist/index.html: GSAP/ScrollTrigger/Lenis loaded. Reveal system with clip/fade/scale variants. Split text and rotator defined. Breaker handle flip implied. Reduced motion disables transforms. ≥3 hook types beyond plain reveals.

wow.notes: dist/index.html + concept.json: Panel Schedule filling on scroll is tied to thesis and trade. Breaker UI in hero signals interaction. Tool output designed in signature language.

polish.notes: dist/index.html: SVG favicon, apple-touch-icon, OG 1200×630, theme-color, Electrician JSON-LD, print stylesheet, forced-colors. Consistent 2px radius. Footer uses signature circuit. Round 1 broken credit links resolved (now plain li text).

elevate.move: When real media loads, leverage the existing CSS grade filter (grayscale+sepia+contrast+brightness with tone-specific blend modes) and object-position on thirds to make every frame read as one shoot, pushing photo from 8.0 toward 9.0.
Thread circuit-rail numbering into pricing table rows (e.g., 'C-12 Panel replacement') so the signature organizes data rather than decorating it, satisfying the cover-the-logo test for a 10.
